To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

organizational learning capacity and organizational knowledge base are important factors affecting the top executives’ attitudes and adoption intention toward an information technology in small businesses.
organizational learning capacity and organizational knowledge resource are important factors that influence top executives’ attitudes and their decision to adopt an information technology innovation.

organizational learning capacity and organizational knowledge resource have a positive effect on top executives’ attitudes towards IT innovation and that top executives’ attitude towards IT innovation has a positive effect on the intention to adopt IT innovation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role that organizational learning capacity and organizational knowledge resource play in top executives’ attitudes formation and decision to adopt new information technology.
the adoption of information technology by small businesses, and the influence of organizational resources on this process.
the influence of organizational factors on the adoption of new technology by small businesses.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the learning capacity and knowledge resources are the key determinants of the top executives’ attitudes and their adoption intention of new technology, which are in turn the major determinants of small business’ assimilation of the new technology.

the learning capacity and knowledge resources of an organization have an impact on top executives’ decision formation for IT innovation adoption, and that the executives’ attitudes toward the innovation mediate this influence.
the organizational assimilation of information technologies is dependent on the executive decision to adopt the technologies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

organizational knowledge resource and organizational learning capacity are important antecedents of top executives’ decision formation for IT assimilation, and that top executives’ attitude is the mediating variable between organizational knowledge resource and capacity and top executives’ decision for IT adoption.

the organizational learning and knowledge base are important in the process of technology adoption in small business context and that the organizational learning capacity and top executives’ learning attitude are important in the adoption decision.

organizational learning capacity and organizational knowledge resource are important determinants of organizational assimilation of information technologies, and the influence is mediated through top executives’ adoption intentions.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the top executives’ learning capacity and knowledge resources play a significant role in influencing their attitudes and decisions toward IT innovation, and hence their organizations’ assimilation of new technologies.
the top executives’ attitudes are the most important factor affecting the adoption of new technologies by small businesses.
small organizations need to invest in organizational learning capacity to improve their top executives’ decision-making ability in IT adoption.
